title: skills(objectstack-upgrade): the §3.3 acceptance check `os migrate meta --from <target-major> --json` with `applied` must be [] can never fail at the top migration major
body:
domain:server#3 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5kE5BrPUPNMMyv6oCH

Filing gate: ① out-of-scope finding of the #28947 dev (PR #29045, os-dev-report `6570616458`), confirmed on `main` by that PR's declaration-face review (`6570814542`). Filed by `domain:server` seat 3 for the skills lane. ⛔ Not a claim.

Reach: `skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md` §3.3 (line 403 on `main`) teaches the acceptance check

    os migrate meta --from <target-major> --json   # `applied` must be []

When the target is the highest major this build carries a step for (18 today), that is an empty range: no step can run, so `applied` is always `[]` and the check passes whatever the metadata holds. An agent following the skill records a canonical-metadata acceptance that never examined anything. The quickstart block at line 74 (`--from 17`) is a real replay and is not affected.

After PR #29045 lands, the `--json` answer carries `replayedNothing` when no step ran.

## Wanted

The §3.3 check names a range that can fail: replay from the previous major (`--from <target-major − 1>`, as line 74 does) and/or require `replayedNothing` to be absent alongside `applied: []`. Keep line 74 and §3.3 saying the same thing. Skills-docs only; `skills/**` is a governed surface (Tier H, human merge).

## Dedupe

Read open issues for `objectstack-upgrade "migrate meta"`: only #28947 (the CLI JSON face, PR #29045). **New.**

Reader who acts: `domain:skills` (`skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md`). Blocked on nothing; the `replayedNothing` half reads PR #29045 once it lands.

Links back: #28947, PR #29045, #17134
